network.comment: Layer 1 allow: stable NetBird FQDN for proxy-peer. Layer 2 (NetBird route enable/disable on mitmproxy's wt0) controls whether the connection actually succeeds.

_layer1_mesh_notes: Layer 1 (mitmproxy allow/deny) decides whether mitmproxy forwards the request.
Mesh permission is a NetBird dashboard ACL (groups + TCP 8080), not a sandcat lease.
Delete the Default All-to-All policy or the custom ACL has no effect.
